**ID:** Bu-Vb Np12  
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)  
**Collection:** Vinaya  
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 12  
**Title (English, from literature):** Making a blanket entirely of black wool

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Suddhakāla Sutta* (Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 12) is a disciplinary rule within the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule lays down that any monk who makes a blanket or rug entirely out of black sheep's wool commits an offense requiring forfeiture (*nissaggiya*) and formal confession (*pācittiya*). A modern English translation has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
